title: Set A · Business Management Paper 1 · Pre-release statement
text: HarbourLoop Ltd leases reusable transport boxes to independent food shops in a coastal region. Its customers pay per delivery. The boxes remain HarbourLoop’s property and must return to its wash centre before reuse. The founders own all ordinary shares. They plan to seek growth outside the current region. Students may find it helpful to research reverse logistics, deposit systems and the difference between owning a product and paying for its use. All organisations and figures in these papers are fictional.
